title: Source-bound requirement applicability annotations
target_user: A session-bound project administrator and assigned reviewer who must distinguish inapplicable requirements from missing evidence
observed_problem: The PRD mentions not_applicable, but current checklist items represent broad categories without requirement-scoped applicability evidence, and package conversion defaults unrecognized statuses to ready.

evidence.observation: The current model has category/status/evidence but no requirement applicability assessment or immutable actor/source binding.
Only blocked and action_needed/unknown are explicitly mapped; the fallback is ready.
An existing session-bound administrator guard rejects Ops-key-only access and can be reused for explicit applicability authorship.
Proposes evidence-bound requirement annotations rather than excluding whole categories or bypassing filters. Depends on approved opportunity identity integration.

current_workaround: Keep uncertainty as action_needed/unknown and explain non-applicability in prose; it is not a structured source-bound assessment.
desired_outcome: Record and export a traceable human applicability judgment for an individual requirement without changing business approval, score or mandatory filters.
acceptance_criteria: Keep all ten category rows; add stable child requirement identity and explicit applies/not_applicable/unknown annotations, initially unknown.
Only current session-bound administrators may author, change or retract annotations; API/Ops keys alone and unassigned members cannot write.
N/A requires rationale, exact current source snapshot hash and quote range plus server-derived actor/time; absence of text is not evidence of non-applicability.
Reject N/A where relevant server-mapped hard filters fail or remain unknown; preserve blocking state, scores, recommendation and false operational authority.
Changing source makes prior annotation stale and current applicability unknown; changing an annotation invalidates dependent review/Council/document freshness.
Retain every prior annotation and existing package byte sequence; expose explicit applicability in a versioned package format without N/A-to-ready fallback.
Local/fake-S3 tests cover wrong scope, missing evidence, duplicate operations, revision races, stale sources and export round trips before exposing UI writes.
affected_boundaries: Procurement requirement/applicability schemas and versioned decision storage
Session-bound project requirement annotation routes using existing administrator authentication
Checklist source binding, evidence history and decision freshness
Package schema/version validators, generation context and HTML/Markdown/DOCX renderers
Procurement browser requirement controls and focused local/API/browser verification

allowed_effects: After scoped approval, implement and verify only isolated local and fake-S3 workflows described by the candidate design
Preserve existing snapshots, completed packages, receipts and unrelated dirty changes
excluded_effects: Modify real user DATA_DIR contents or perform an unapproved migration
Invoke live G2B, AWS, providers, training, deployment or publication
Commit, push, install dependencies, change credentials or grant operational authority
separate_approval_required_for: External service calls, paid execution, deployment, commit or push

local_verification.proves: Existing recommendation, package, access and rendering regression boundaries; isolate sync browser tests if the selected runner requires it.
Planned new test file: source/actor binding, hard-filter non-bypass, local/fake-S3 revision conflict, history and versioned export semantics. Not implemented or run.
Planned new test file: real local administrator annotation, assignee read-only inspection, source change and package reload across desktop/mobile. Not implemented or run.

decision.rationale: The repository operator accepted the linked design and local/fake-S3 scope with '좋아 이어서 완벽하게 계획 세워서 진행하자' after the explicit design approval request. Proceed in the current task; real-data migration and all excluded effects remain unauthorized.
